name: Classify and categorize items into groups
description: Users asked to classify, categorize, or group specific items, topics, data points, or concepts into predefined or generated categories, often based on provided criteria, attributes, or similarity. This included tasks ranging from matching list items to one-to-one correspondences and ranking items within categories to identifying standard industry or scientific classifications.
